Source dimensions & modelling limits

Authority: Ashley Lewchuk, 79 Chemin Musie – Kitchen v.4.pdf, September 2026. Earlier V.2/V.3 concepts and generated images are retained only for historical comparison and styling. This is a three-dimensional concept model, not a measured as-built or fabrication model.

  • A.03 (PDF p.4): room and flooring dimensions are interpreted from the current v.4 plan. Position offsets and wall thicknesses are not surveyed.
  • A.06 / A.10 / A.12 / A.14 (pp.7, 11, 13, 15): cabinet module widths/heights and current fixed layout. Visible fronts, fillers and reveals are simplified.
  • A.08 (p.9): current countertop intent is 2 cm quartz. OGP price-matched Eternal Musq at $5,936 + HST and Calacatta Prado at $6,193.50 + HST; backsplash “X” is $310 + HST. The sink run is about 147″ × 25⅝″ and the small quartz backsplash about 146¼″ × 4 3/16″. Final field template controls.
  • A.10: CAB-3 is the 36″ sink cabinet. The exact apron sink and its support system are not yet selected, so the bowl/cutout shown here is only a placeholder.
  • Glass: V.4 uses glass/mullion fronts on upper CAB-11/12/13/14/16/18. The Historical V.2 button is an appearance comparison only and does not represent the signed current scope.
  • Appliance garage: removed from the current V.4 scope. Older appliance-garage hinge and shortened-counter assumptions are superseded.
  • Floor: current selection is Centura Cerdomus Valdorcia Terracotta Mix Natura in mixed sizes. The 3D floor now uses a representative modular pattern based on the 8×8 / 8×16 / 16×16 / 16×24 format family and the client-supplied Centura pattern reference; final installer layout controls. The current purchase basis is 240.25 sq.ft. and the v.4 design estimate is about 235 sq.ft. including overage.
  • Appliances: existing appliances are retained for now. Matte-white GE Café products remain future alternatives; meshes are generic and do not validate fit or services.
  • Services: electrical, plumbing and HVAC rough-ins occur while walls are open. Verify the range electrical requirement and return-air rerouting before wall closure.
  • IKEA reconciliation: the 22 September list broadly maps to V.4, but CAB-8’s hidden inner drawer is not apparent in the 18″ base components and one $66 36×30 wall cabinet remains that may be the hood cabinet earlier identified for removal. Confirm with Ashley before ordering.
  • Centura payment: $4,387.28 matches the earlier combined kitchen + basement order, not the current kitchen-only scope. With the basement 16×16 line deferred, the mixed-format kitchen line is $2,242.42 pre-tax (about $2,533.93 with 13% HST).
  • Budget: the $30,000 figure remains a legacy working ceiling and is not reaffirmed by the current source set. Current priced/planning scope already exceeds it before several labour/services are priced. No purchasing or fabrication approval is created by this studio.

How to use the studio

1. Start from the V.4 baseline or choose an appearance comparison in Design.
2. Click or tap a cabinet. Set its finish, front and mullions in Item.
3. Use “Apply finish to” for a group, or “Copy appearance” between cabinets.
4. Save two concepts and compare their individual choices.
5. Open Budget to see which prices need refreshing.

Undo / redo includes design and budget edits. Keyboard: Ctrl/⌘ Z to undo; Ctrl/⌘ Shift Z to redo. Escape clears selection. Tap the panel icon at the top for an unobstructed full view.
